meta.conventions: Moonrise/moonset: upper limb, standard refraction, sea level, from the place itself; the first of each between sunrise and the next sunrise, null when there is none. Lunar month: new moon to new moon, index 0 = Chaitra; adhika when the Sun is in one sidereal sign (mean Lahiri) at both new moons; purnimanta dark fortnight takes the next name. Times are UTC.
